mainEntity.name: What should I bring to my first team training session?

acceptedAnswer.text: For your first team training session at Cave Training, you should bring comfortable athletic wear, appropriate athletic shoes, and a water bottle to stay hydrated. Considering the functional movements involved, footwear that offers good stability and support is recommended. You may also want to bring a small towel. There are no special requirements for equipment as all necessary gear for functional fitness, such as kettlebells and ropes, is provided by the gym.
